insights.one_liner: Independent assurance and risk management expert that certifies ships, energy and industry; an IND sponsor, but its current Rotterdam job requires Dutch.

culture.text: Describes itself as the independent expert in assurance and risk management, aiming to safeguard life, property and the environment.
Its work spans ship classification, offshore energy and certification, such as approving MX3D's metal 3D-printing facility.

open.text: DNV Netherlands B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Its open entry-level risk and compliance job in Rotterdam requires Dutch and drew about 200 LinkedIn applicants on average.

growth.text: Expanded its smart shipping centre of excellence in Singapore.
Launched a naval centre in Australia and New Zealand to support defence.

worth_knowing.text: DNV and agency Yune won three Dolphins at Cannes for marketing work.
